patterns.note: High-contrast dark mode with vibrant, almost neon, accent colors for interactive elements and visual content, creating a digital aesthetic.
Content is primarily centered within full-width sections, using generous vertical spacing to create an airy feel between distinct feature blocks.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement. A dynamic audio waveform graphic animates into a sticky header element upon scroll.
Product features and examples are showcased through embedded, animated visualizer previews that transition from static placeholders to vibrant content upon scroll.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered content reveals are used throughout the page, where sections fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down. The hero section's content scrolls out, and a dynamic audio waveform graphic animates from the bottom of the page to become a persistent, sticky header element, likely leveraging WebGL for its visual complexity.

The site employs a dark theme with high contrast, using a deep black background for all sections. Interactive elements and visual examples feature vibrant, neon-like colors to create a striking digital aesthetic.
Product examples are presented as interactive or video-based visualizers, likely rendered using WebGL/Three.js, showcasing the dynamic output of the tool directly on the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear, legible body text and small, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card edges, maintaining a modern, soft feel without being fully pill-shaped.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and content blocks, creating a sense of openness and clear hierarchy.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep black background contrasted with vibrant, almost neon, digital-art style visualizers and a dynamic, animated audio waveform that transforms into a sticky header. It creates a highly immersive and modern aesthetic, emphasizing the product's visual output and interactive nature.
